critical_code_review_comments: pretrade_twin.py: verdict is downscale-only (SKIP or REDUCE with fraction<1 or TRADE with fraction=1); persistence is best-effort (try/except swallows) so the pipeline never blocks on bookkeeping — correct defensive posture. DEEP_MC_ITERS=300 with fixed seed=7 → deterministic (verified in unit test test_twin_deep_mc_deterministic_and_gates).

broker_intel.execution_matrix: correctly groups by (broker,symbol,session) using UTC hours (7-12 london/12-16 overlap/16-21 newyork/asia otherwise), reads slippage_pips + latency_trace.t9_ms-t7_ms, treats status=='failed' as reject-only (not counted in slips/lats), aggregates broker score weighted by cell.submissions — sound design. matrix_cell_score caps slip penalty at 40, latency at 30, reject at 30 so worst possible = 0.

portfolio_risk.marginal_factor_verdict: only reports a breach when after-exposure > cap AND grew (|after|>|before|) — prevents flagging trades that REDUCE an existing factor breach. Approved fraction = 1 − worst_over/candidate_risk (never below 0) — clean derivation.

portfolio_risk.evaluate + marginal_verdict: vol_stress correctly tightens correlations via sign*min(1, |c|+0.35*vs) — verified in unit + integration; marginal_verdict floors the approved fraction by min(cluster_fraction, factor_fraction) so factor budget can only shrink further, never loosen.

uncertainty_engine.assess: components dict is always populated (regime_uncertainty + execution_uncertainty even when history is thin); hard_gate only fires when n>=MIN_SAMPLES_HARD_GATE(30) AND lower<=cost — correct — advisory-only for thin history. conformal_interval uses split-conformal with median as center — distribution-free coverage; unit test test_conformal_interval_coverage_shape asserts ≥85% empirical inside-rate.

strategy_router: HEALTH_ROUTER_MULT floors at 0.5 for DISABLED so a downed family still gets attention (never zero'd) — spec-compliant; recency_weight uses 21-day half-life (0.5 at 21d verified numerically). engine_version bumped to 2 in the live GET /api/brain/router payload.
execution_alpha.classify: EXECUTE_NOW / WAIT / REDUCE / SKIP is the only mode set; LIMIT/SPLIT are advisory-only and never block (verified in test_alpha_split_and_limit_advisory).
brain_routes: broker-matrix/execution-alpha/twin endpoints use admin=True on cookie session admin path (verified live 200 with empty datasets), documented note field for user-facing explainer.

context_for_next_testing_agent: v60 Execution Intelligence is fully verified — no outstanding issues. (2) broker_intel.execution_matrix reads created_at (ISO string) not the ObjectId for the time filter and does the recency window in ISO string compare — seed created_at with a recent datetime.isoformat().
